senses.gloss:
निः निः, euphonically substituted for निस्,
q. v., before श्, ष्, स्, and rarely before क्, ख्, प्, फ्.

निःक˚ निः-क˚, निः-का˚, &c. See under
निष्-क˚, निष्-का˚, &c.

निःक्षत्र निः-क्षत्र or निः-क्षत्रिय, अस्,
आ, अम्, destitute of the military tribe, having no
warrior-caste.

निःक्षिप् निः-क्षिप्, probably for नि-क्षिप्,
q. v.

निः-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or sent away;
spent (as time), passed.

निः-क्षिप्य, ind. having thrown or sent away;
having spent (as time); having wiped away (as tears).

निः-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing, sending, putting
away; spending, passing (time); wiping away (as
tears).

निःप˚ निः-प˚ and निः-फ˚. See under
निष्-प˚ and निष्-फ˚.

निःशंसय निः-शंसय, wrongly spelt for
निः-संशय.

निःसंशय निः-संशय, अस्, आ, अम्, un-
doubted, infallible, unerring, certain; not doubting,
not doubtful; (अम्), ind. without doubt, doubtless,
infallibly, certainly, surely.

निःशङ्क निः-शङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
fear, fearless, without misgiving or apprehension,
having no cares, free from risk; (अम्), ind. fearlessly,
without fear or care, without anxiety.
—निःशङ्क-
सुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping without care, sleeping
calmly and securely.

निः-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, free from fear or care,
free from risk, secure.

निःशब्द निः-शब्द, अस्, आ, अम्, noiseless,
soundless, not making a noise; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (?),
soundlessness, silence, a calm; (अम्), ind. without
noise, noiselessly; [cf. नि-शब्द.]

निःशम निः-शम, अस्, m. uneasiness, dis-
composure, anxiety.

निःशयान निः-शयान, अस्, आ, अम्, not sleep-
ing, not lying down.

निःशरण निः-शरण, अस्, आ, अम्, without
protection or refuge, defenceless, unprotected.

निःसरण निः-सरण. See under निः-सृ,
col. 2.

निः-सरण, अम्, n. going forth or out, coming
forth, exit; the egress or outlet from a house,
market-place, town, &c., the gate, the gate-way;
a means or expedient, a remedy; departure, dying,
death; final beatitude.

निः-सारण, अम्, n. driving out, expelling, turn-
ing out; the egress or outlet from a building, town,
&c., a passage, road of ingress or egress.

निःशर्कर निः-शर्कर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
stones or pebbles (as a bathing-place).

निःशलाक निः-शलाक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
talking birds (as parrots, jays, or crows); solitary, private.

निःशल्य निः-शल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from
an arrow; free from spikes or thorns; (अम्), ind.
without an arrow; unthorny; without pain or diffi-
culty; without reluctance, willingly.

निःशस् निः-शस्, f., Ved. refusing, declin-
ing; (Sāy.) disinclination, absence of wish or desire,
dislike (= निः-शंसन).

निःशास् निः-शास् (निस्-श्˚), cl. 2. P. -शास्ति,
-शासितुम्, Ved. to order off or away; to expel.

निःशस्त्र निः-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, without
arms, unarmed, weaponless.

निःशिष् निः-शिष् (निस्-श्˚), Caus. -शेषयति,
-यितुम्, to take away or destroy completely, con-
sume entirely, annihilate; (also regarded as a Nom.
fr. निः-शेष.)

निः-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, having no remainder, with-
out remainder, completely spent, complete, entire,
whole, (often in the sense of an adverb at the be-
ginning of a comp. before a participle, e. g. निः-
शेष-भग्न, completely broken); (अम् or एण),
ind. completely, totally; निःशेषं कृ, to destroy
or consume completely; [cf. अ-शेष.]
—निःशेष-
तस्, ind. without remainder, completely, totally.
—निःशेष-ता, f. complete destruction.
निःशेष निः-शेष. See निः-शिष् above.
निः-शेषण, अस्, आ, अम्, = निः-शेष.

निःशुक्र निः-शुक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. without
brilliancy; without virile energy, impotent.

निःशूक निः-शूक, अस्, m. beardless rice
without any awn.

निःशोक निः-शोक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
sorrow or care.

निःशोध्य निः-शोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be
purified, not requiring cleansing; clean, pure.

निःश्मश्रु निः-श्मश्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, beardless;
(wrongly read नि-श्मश्रु.)
निःश्रम निः-श्रम. See नि-श्रम.

निःश्रयणी निः-श्रयणी or निः-श्रयिणी, f. a
ladder, a staircase, steps, &c.; [cf. नि-श्रयणी, नि-
श्रयिणी.]

निः-श्रेणि, इस्, ई, f. a ladder or staircase, a flight of
stairs or steps; the wild date tree.
निःश्रेणि निः-श्रेणि. See above.
निःश्रेणिका, f. a species of grass.

निःश्री निः-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, deprived of happi-
ness or prosperity, unfortunate.
—निःश्री-कृत, अस्,
आ, अम्, made unfortunate, rendered unhappy.

निःश्रीक, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of beauty (as a
dead body), deprived of happiness, &c.; one whose
happiness is destroyed, unhappy, inglorious; (also
read नि-श्रीक.)
—निःश्रीक-ता, f. absence of good
fortune, want of good luck.

निःश्रेयस निः-श्रेयस, अस्, ई, अम्, having
nothing better or superior, the best, most excellent;
(अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. final beatitude,
ultimate bliss or supreme felicity in the life to come,
happiness, welfare; knowledge which brings deliver-
ance, learning; belief, faith, devotedness; appre-
hension, conception.

निःश्वस् निः-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति, -श्वसि-
तुम्, to breathe out, expire, sigh.
निः-श्वसन, अम्, n. breathing out, sighing.

निः-श्वस्य, ind. having sighed, sighing, breath-
ing out.

निः-श्वास, अस्, m. breathing out, expiration;
breath, sighing, a sigh; (often read नि-श्वास.)
—निः-
श्वास-परम, अस्, आ, अम्, chiefly engaged in sigh-
ing, melancholy, sorrowful.
—निःश्वास-संहिता, f.,
N. of a code of laws supposed to have been revealed
by Rudra-Śiva.

निःषमम् निः-षमम्, ind. (fr. निस् + स-
मम्), at the wrong time, unseasonably.

निःषिध् निः-षिध्, त्, f. (fr. निस् + सिध् =
साध्), granting, bestowing; grant, oblation, gift,
donation; (Sāy.) hindrance, obstruction; destroying,
destructive, adverse.

निः-षिध्वन्, आ, अरी, अ (fr. निस् + सिध्वन्),
[]
Ved. granting, presenting; (Sāy.) coming to com-
plete perfection.

निःसङ्कक्ष निः-सङ्कक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not per-
plexed, not confused; (also written नि-सङ्कक्ष.)

निःसङ्ख्य निः-सङ्ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, innu-
merable, numberless.

निःसङ्ग निः-सङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, unattached,
unobstructed; not attached, not devoted, regardless,
indifferent to (with loc.); free from worldly attach-
ment or selfish desires, unselfish, disinterested; un-
connected, separated; (एन or अम्), ind. without
attachment, without interest, unselfishly, without
further reflection; (also written निः-षङ्ग; cf.
अ-सङ्ग.)
—निःसङ्ग-ता, f. or निःसङ्ग-त्व, अम्,
n. absence of attachment, unselfishness, disinterested-
ness, indifference.

निःसञ्चार निः-सञ्चार, अस्, आ, अम्, not mov-
ing, not walking about, not leaving one's home.

निःसञ्ज्ञ निः-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, senseless,
insensible, unconscious.

निःसत्य निः-सत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, untrue, false.
—निःसत्य-ता, f. insincerity, falsehood, untruth.

निःसन्तति निः-सन्तति, इस्, इस्, इ, destitute
of offspring, childless.

निः-सन्तान, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of posterity,
childless.

निःसन्दिग्ध निः-सन्दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, un-
doubted, not doubtful, certain; (अम्), ind. without
any doubt, certainly.

निः-सन्देह, अस्, आ, अम्, free from uncertainty,
doubtless, undoubted, certain; (अम्), ind. without
any doubt, certainly.

निःसन्धि निः-सन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, having no
joints, having no joints perceptible, well knit, com-
pact, close, firm.

निःसपत्न निः-सपत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, having
no rival, not sharing the possession of anything with
another; not claimed by another, belonging exclu-
sively to one possessor; having no enemies.

निःसम्पात निः-सम्पात, अस्, आ, अम्, afford-
ing no passage, blocked up; (अस्), m. thick dark-
ness, midnight.

निःसम्बन्ध निः-सम्बन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, with-
out relatives.

निःसम्बाध निः-सम्बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, not
contracted, large, spacious.

निःसम्भ्रम निः-सम्भ्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, not
perplexed or flurried, unembarrassed.

निःसलिल निः-सलिल, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless,
having no water.

निःसहाय निः-सहाय, अस्, आ, अम्, without
helpers or associates, unassisted.

निःसाध्वस निः-साध्वस, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless,
[]
bold; (अम्), ind. fearlessly, boldly.
—निःसाध्वस-
त्व, अम्, n. fearlessness, boldness.

निःसामर्थ्य निः-सामर्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit,
unsuitable.

निःसामान्य निः-सामान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, extra-
ordinary, uncommon, unusual, special.

निःसार 1. निः-सार, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. निः-
सार see under निः-सृ below), sapless, pithless,
worthless, vain, vapid, unsubstantial; (अस्), m. the plant
Trophis Aspera; a kind of time in music; (आ), f.
the pisang, Musa Sapientum (= कदली).
—निःसार-
ता, f. saplessness, worthlessness, vanity.

2. निः-सार, अस्, m. (for 1. निः-सार see above),
going forth or out.

निः-सर, अस्, आ, अम्, issuing out.
—निःसर-
त्व, अम्, n. = पित्त-रोग.

निःसाल निः-साल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being
out of the house.

निःसीमन् निः-सीमन्, आ, आ, अ, immeasurable,
having no boundaries or limits.

निःसुख निः-सुख, अस्, आ, अम्, joyless, sad,
unhappy; disagreeable, distressing.

निःसृ निः-सृ (निस्-स्˚), cl. 1. P. -सरति,
-सर्तुम्, to go out, come forth, issue, slip out,
depart, withdraw: Caus. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to go out or away, turn out, expel.

निः-सारित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned out, made to come
out, expelled, dismissed.

निः-सार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be turned out, to be
excluded or expelled.

निः-सृत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth or out, broken
forth; having departed (with abl.).

निःस्तम्भ निः-स्तम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, without
posts or columns, having no pillars.

निःस्तुति निः-स्तुति, इस्, इस्, इ (also read नि-
स्तुति), praising nothing, without praising (anything).

निःस्नेह निः-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, without
unction, not greasy or unctuous, dry; without love
or affection, insensible, cold, unfeeling; not longing
for, indifferent; not loved, uncared for, hated; (आ),
f. linseed, Linum Usitatissimum.
—निःस्नेह-फला,
f. a species of Solanum with white flowers.
निःस्पन्द निः-स्पन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, motionless.

निःस्पृह निः-स्पृह, अस्, आ, अम् (often written
नि-स्पृह), free from desire; disregarding, indiffer-
ent to (with abl.); content, unenvious.
निःस्यन्द निः-स्यन्द. See नि-स्यन्द.

निःस्रु निः-स्रु (निस्-स्˚), Caus. -स्रावयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to flow out or off, to empty.

निः-स्रव, अस्, m. remainder, surplus, overplus
(with abl.).

निः-स्राव, अस्, m. causing to flow out, expending,
expense; the moisture or water of boiled rice; [cf.
नि-स्राव.]

निःस्व निः-स्व, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of one's
own, having no property, indigent, poor.
—निःस्व-
ता, f. poverty.
—निःस्वी-कृत or निःस्वी-भूत, अस्,
आ, अम्, deprived of one's property, impoverished.

निःस्वन निः-स्वन, अस्, m. (fr. स्वन् with
निस्), sound, noise, voice; [cf. नि-स्वन.]

निःस्वभाव निः-स्वभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, void of
peculiarities, without peculiar properties.

निःस्वादु निः-स्वादु, उस्, उस् or द्वी, उ, taste-
less, void of flavour, insipid, unsavoury.

निःस्वाध्याय निः-स्वाध्याय, अस्, आ, अम्, not
muttering prayers, not repeating texts.
—निःस्वा-
ध्याय-वषट्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, neither repeating
holy texts nor sacrificing.
